name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

angles.text: Druids from Zephras commune with the windborne cat spirit to master their feline form, completing a rite tailored to their unique heritage rather than the traditional Azerothian path.
Addressed as shen'dorei, Skyborne druids are guided by the spirits of their homeland of Zephras rather than adopting the indigenous forms of Azeroth.

aliases: who is the windborne cat spirit
faq.answer: The windborne cat spirit is manifest as the Avatar of Saeyleenan, a spirit hailing from the distant homeland of Zephras. It has traveled to Moonglade to mentor and test young shen'dorei druids seeking to adopt its feline shape.
faq.q: Who is the Great Windborne Cat Spirit?

aliases: where to find cat spirit moonglade
faq.answer: The spirit's avatar appears in the southern reaches of Moonglade, situated just south of the twin bridges.
faq.q: Where can the Avatar of Saeyleenan be found?

aliases: why does cat form look different
faq.answer: Because shen'dorei druids originate from Zephras, their feline shape reflects the windborne spirits of their homeland rather than the native big cats of Azeroth. The spirit personally oversees their trial to ensure they properly embody its essence.
faq.q: Why do Zephras druids commune with a different cat spirit?

aliases: what trial does the cat spirit give
how to get windborne cat form
faq.answer: The Avatar of Saeyleenan has the initiate undertake the trial of Azeroth's Great Cat Spirit, while stepping in personally to supervise and confirm that the druid comprehends the windborne spirit's unique nature.
faq.q: What does the trial of the windborne cat entail?

faq.answer: The Avatar of Saeyleenan addresses the initiate as shen'dorei, denoting their origin from Zephras and distinguishing their heritage and spiritual practices from the native peoples of Azeroth.
Zephras is the distant homeland of the shen'dorei. Its native flora, fauna, and spirits differ noticeably from those of Azeroth, giving rise to unique shapeshifting forms among its druids.

sections.body: In the sacred sanctuary of Moonglade, a spirit of the distant realm of Zephras has manifested south of the twin bridges. Calling itself the Avatar of Saeyleenan, this windborne cat spirit has crossed into Azeroth to guide and tutor young shen'dorei druids who are ready to unlock their feline shapeshifting form.
sections.title: A Visitor from Zephras

sections.body: While all druids eventually seek the wisdom of the feline form, those from Zephras carry a tradition distinct from the native inhabitants of Azeroth. Rather than adopting the form of an Azerothian wildcat, the shen'dorei embody the windborne predator of their homeland. To ensure they grasp its spiritual nature, Saeyleenan oversees their trial in Moonglade firsthand.
sections.title: The Nature of the Windborne Form

summary: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit is a sacred mentor from the realm of Zephras that appears as the Avatar of Saeyleenan in Moonglade. It guides young shen'dorei druids through their spiritual trial so they may embody the windborne feline form of their distant homeland.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
